messages:
alia: Quick update: we're introducing stricter CI linting for docs samples and will deprecate a set of old code snippets that rely on legacy SDK behavior. Aim: keep examples runnable and aligned with current SDK/console defaults.

ben: what's the scope? all languages or just the primary SDKs?

alia: initial sweep targets JS/Python/Go samples in the public docs. We'll expand to other examples later. Key changes: remove samples that use `implicit auth` or `legacy client()` calls, require explicit `api_key` or `auth_provider` in examples, and update snippet outputs to match SDK v4 semantics.

nora: timeline?

alia: plan: 2026-04-06 publish lint rules and a migration checklist; 2026-04-13 enable soft-lint (CI warnings only); 2026-05-04 hard-lint (CI failures) for docs PRs. Deprecated snippet list published 04/06.

docs-bot: Draft lint rule set posted: https://go.redwood/internal/docs-lint-rules. Sample required header: ```
# Example header required in docs snippets
# rw_example: {"auth": "explicit", "sdk_version": ">=4.0.0", "tested": "2026-04-01"}
```

eng-sdk: SDK note: we'll add a compatibility shim for `client()` that emits a single deprecation warning for 30 days after hard-lint goes live. No behavioral changes during soft-lint.

ben: will this break existing pasted snippets in customer apps?

alia: no runtime change expected; only docs and CI. We will provide a small migration helper script: `rw docs-fix-snippets` that rewrites headers and updates minimal shape changes.

support-bot: Action item: Support to prepare a KB article for customers who report snippet mismatches. ETA: 2026-04-10.

nora: can we add a docs badge showing 'snippet tested' status so readers know the sample is runnable?

docs-bot: Good idea. We'll add a small green badge visible on sample blocks when tests pass. docs CI will auto-update status.

ben: any legal or security concerns?

eng-sdk: Security reviewed: requiring explicit auth in docs is good. No KMS impact. Logging will not capture keys.

alia: owners: @docs-bot (lint rules + badge), @eng-sdk (shim + fix script), @support-bot (KB readiness). If you see gaps, ping me. We'll announce the deprecated snippet list on 04/06 and tag maintainers where possible. Thanks! :sparkles:
